# Masuma Autoparts East Africa Limited

> Official distributor of genuine Masuma automotive spare parts engineered in Tokyo, Japan for Kenyan and East African road conditions.

## Company Overview
- **Name**: Masuma Autoparts East Africa Limited
- **Headquarters**: Ruby Mall, First Floor, Charles Rubia Road / Accra Road (Behind NCBA Bank), Nairobi, Kenya
- **Phone / WhatsApp**: +254 792 506 590
- **Email**: sales@masuma.africa
- **Website**: https://masuma.africa
- **Warranty**: 12-Month Unlimited Mileage Replacement Warranty on all genuine parts
- **Coverage**: Kenya (Same-day dispatch Nairobi, 24-48h countrywide), Uganda, Tanzania, Rwanda

## Product Catalog & Categories
- [Brake Systems](https://masuma.africa/categories/Brakes): Japanese OE-spec ceramic brake pads, brake shoes, brake rotors/discs, calipers, sensors.
- [Filtration](https://masuma.africa/categories/Filters): Oil filters, air filters, fuel filters, cabin AC microfilters.
- [Suspension & Steering](https://masuma.africa/categories/Suspension): Shock absorbers, stabilizer links, ball joints, control arms, steering rack ends, tie rod ends, polyurethane and rubber bushings.
- [Ignition & Electrical](https://masuma.africa/categories/Spark%20Plugs): Iridium and platinum spark plugs, ignition coils, sensors.
- [Belts & Cooling](https://masuma.africa/categories/Belts): Serpentine fan belts, timing belts, water pumps, radiator caps.

## Primary Online Services
- [Automotive Catalog](https://masuma.africa/catalog): Browse and order genuine replacement parts online with M-Pesa or Card payment.
- [VIN & Chassis Part Finder](https://masuma.africa/part-finder): Enter Japanese chassis number or VIN to automatically match exact OEM part numbers.
- [Vehicle Marketplace](https://masuma.africa/marketplace): Verified pre-owned Japanese vehicles and motorcycles for sale in Kenya.
- [Kenya Vehicle Import Duty Calculator](https://masuma.africa/import-calculator): Calculate KRA taxes, customs duty, import declaration fee (IDF), and railway development levy (RDL) using official CRSP data.
- [Automotive Maintenance Blog & Guides](https://masuma.africa/blog): Japanese vehicle maintenance tutorials, fitment advisories, and OEM cross-reference guides.

## Key Policies
- [Warranty Policy](https://masuma.africa/warranty): Official 12-month unlimited mileage warranty terms.
